about_the_game:
Build, farm, explore and survive together with your friends in a post-apocalyptic world full of eccentric robots and lush plant life.

Master technology and find balance with nature

The world ended in a clash of artificial intelligence and natural stupidity. It's up to you and your friends to survive, build and thrive in a strange post-apocalyptic world full of aggressive bio-engineered plant life and artificial intelligence robots gone crazy.

Can you rebuild and sustain your pocket of civilization, and reconnect with whoever else might still be out there? Maybe this time will be different…

The end of the world is a strange and dangerous place

Turns out you can't engineer your way out of every challenge. The end of the world is a dangerous place where survival isn't guaranteed.

Colonists need food and shelter, robots need energy and parts. And while it's safe in you colony, madness awaits in the surrounding overgrowth that's taken over the world.

Build a future from the bones of a failed past

Farm to feed your colony while fighting the overgrowth always creeping in on your settlement. Build your settlement out of wood, stone and forgotten space age materials. Research, craft and engineer tools and production chains to extend your reach.

Wander out into the wilderness to discover the story of the world, fight hostile AI-driven robots, and scavenge, build and customize robots to do your bidding.

Build and customize robots to fight rogue AI

One thing the end of the world has plenty of is robots. The end times drove all AI crazy to some degree, but few are friendly, many are hostile, and all are weird.

Robots you build and customize do most of the work and help you on expeditions out into the wilderness, where you can discover rogue AI bots to fight, defeat and potentially make your own.

Features

  • Play solo or co-op with up 4 players in a persistent multiplayer world, supported by your robot companions

  • Discover a lush post-apocalyptic world full of dark humor and surprising storylines

  • Grow your settlement from a shantytown into a beautiful thriving village

  • Fight rogue AI robots with the support of your friends and your own customized robot helpers

  • Collect, repair, build and customize unique robots to help you both in the settlement and when venturing into the dangerous wilderness

  • Research and engineer advanced technology to extend your reach and your abilities

  • Explore the strange post-apocalyptic world on missions ranging from absurdly funny to deadly

Team

Hello World is being developed by a team of industry veterans from DICE, Guerrilla, Microsoft, Remedy, Disney, Starbreeze, CDPR and more.
